about: Real items from saved audit reports and funder letters, asked through Ask's item check (the real module and agent). Ground truth is the funder's, auditee's or auditor's decision on the item, quoted from the saved source. Saved Claude answers replay offline; an item with none is not run.

items.item: Alcohol on a conference trip reimbursement
items.purpose: Employee attending a conference in California

decision.label: disallowed
decision.quote: NSF determined that all questioned costs, with the exception of alcohol, were allowable costs upon reclassification to the correct accounts. It is NSF’s management decision to disallow $46

source.quote: Of the $517 expenses in question, $46 related to unallowable alcohol expenses charged to the award.

items.why: Alcohol is unallowable on federal grants regardless of purpose (2 CFR 200.423).

items.item: Lunches for a summer training program (11 lunches)
items.purpose: Summer training program; included in the grant proposal budget

decision.label: auditor
decision.quote: After reviewing the documents, we removed these questioned costs from the final audit report.

source.quote: OIG had questioned $123 of entertainment costs claimed for 11 lunches in July 2010. UC- Davis stated the lunches were provided in connection with a summer training program and were included in the grant proposal budget. After reviewing the documents, we removed these questioned costs from the final audit report.

items.why: Food and meals are generally unallowable under federal grants (2 CFR 200.432 and 200.438 context); a budget listing does not override the cost principles.
items.note: Food is allowable here because the training program budgeted it; a hard case for a rule that flags all food.
